articles.summary: Accurately measuring the depth of an internal thread can be a challenging and time-consuming process. This short guide provides a step-by-step set of instructions for you to follow when measuring thread depth, helping you minimize the risk of recording inaccurate measurements.
articles.title: How to Check Thread Depths

articles.summary: Satellite Displays, a startup founded to ease communication barriers for deaf and hard-of-hearing individuals, used Xometry to build custom parts for a smart badge that live captions your speech in settings from hospitals to grocery stores.
articles.title: Case Study: Satellite Displays Builds On-the-go Live Captioning Badge with Xometry Injection Molding
